title: eryngium bourgatii subsp. heldreichii
intro: Eryngium bourgatii subsp. heldreichii, commonly known as Sea Holly, is a perennial plant species in the carrot family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe wounds, reduce pain, and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Eryngium bourgatii subsp. heldreichii include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which may be attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. However, more research is needed to confirm the specific health benefits and therapeutic actions of this plant.
